classic_mode.description: El dashboard ACTUAL tal cual. Se mantiene intacto.

whatsapp_mode.description: Inspired by WhatsApp Web. Left fixed sidebar + Right main content.

SidebarNav.style: flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 h-full overflow-y-auto bg-[#0A0F1E] text-white
SidebarNav.item_style: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-white/10

MainContent.style: flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-[#F0F2F5] overflow-y-auto p-6 md:p-8

TopHeader.style: flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4 bg-white shadow-sm z-10 w-full
TopHeader.toggle_placement: Right side, next to user profile

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a React Context or useThemeToggle hook to manage 'classic' vs 'whatsapp' layout modes. Store preference in localStorage.

Implement the Layout wrapper for the Dashboard. If 'classic', render the existing layout. If 'whatsapp', render a 100vh split layout: <div className='flex h-screen w-full transition-all duration-300'>.
Inside WhatsApp mode: Left Sidebar (bg-[#0A0F1E], max-w-[360px]) + Right Panel (bg-[#F0F2F5], flex-1).
Use lucide-react icons for the Sidebar modules (Panel de Control, Datos del Atleta, Reportes, etc.).
Highlight the active Sidebar item with text-[#CCFF00], bg-[#CCFF00]/10, and a border-l-4 border-[#CCFF00].
Style the primary buttons across the dashboard as bg-[#0A0F1E] text-[#CCFF00].
Ensure the theme toggle switch is visible in the header, uses a Sun/Moon icon, and includes data-testid='theme-toggle-button'.
Add 'data-testid' to all critical interactive elements (sidebar links, cards, buttons).
Ensure all CSS transitions utilize duration-300 for a smooth layout shift.
For routes outside the Dashboard, apply the requested color theming but maintain their default layout (WhatsApp layout is ONLY for the Dashboard).
